_comment: RBG_Runner Workflow Configuration — defines schedules, dependencies, conditions, and priorities for every agent in oc-toolkit. Edit this file to control when and in what order agents run.
_model_comment: OpenCode allows one model per agent (the `model:` line in each agent file = the first entry below). These ordered lists are the backups: rgb_runner.py and the agents retry with the next model when one is retired (410), missing (404), rate-limited (429 after one wait) or times out. heal_models.ps1 sets each agent's `model:` line to the first working entry. Model IDs use OpenCode's built-in 'nvidia' provider. Verified working 2026-09-24. 2026-10-30: nvidia/nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b retired by NVIDIA (Model unavailable) — replaced by nvidia/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b.

do_not_fallback_on: the agent's own task failure (bad output, failed tests)

idea_planner.description: Decomposes a plain-English idea into an ordered task list
idea_planner._schedule_comment: Every Monday at 09:00 UTC — weekly planning session

business_planning._schedule_comment: Every Monday at 10:00 UTC — runs after idea_planner finishes

competitor_research._schedule_comment: Every Wednesday at 09:00 UTC — weekly competitive pulse
competitor_research._cooldown_comment: At most once per day (1440 minutes)

social_media._schedule_comment: On-demand only — triggered manually when content is needed

ads_management.description: Google Ads and Meta campaign planning
ads_management._schedule_comment: Every Tuesday at 09:00 UTC — weekly ads review

email_outreach.description: Cold email sequences and prospect research

customer_support.description: Classify and reply to customer emails
customer_support._priority_comment: Highest priority — support runs before anything else

finance._schedule_comment: First day of every month at 09:00 UTC — monthly financial review

code_generation.description: Production code + tests — always runs alone
code_generation._schedule_comment: On-demand only — never auto-scheduled (requires human review before triggering)
code_generation._priority_comment: Runs alone per hard rule in rgb_runner — never in parallel

deployment.description: Render / GitHub Actions deployment plans — always runs last and alone
deployment._schedule_comment: On-demand only — always runs last, always alone
deployment._priority_comment: Always executes last — enforced by hard rule in rgb_runner

grounded_review.description: Default child validator. RBG_Runner runs it automatically after every worker (see rgb_runner.md Worker → Validator Pairing); it can also be chained explicitly via depends_on.
grounded_review._depends_on_comment: Set depends_on to the agent(s) whose output you want reviewed, e.g. ['idea_planner']
grounded_review._schedule_comment: On-demand only — always chained explicitly after the agent being reviewed

linkedin.description: All LinkedIn operations — posts, comments, replies, profile, analytics. Always draft → user approval → publish.
linkedin._schedule_comment: On-demand only — publishing always needs explicit user approval

user_testing_validator.description: Milestone behavior validator — starts the app and checks the milestone's behavior assertions against the running app. Only used inside missions, after a milestone's tasks are done.
user_testing_validator._schedule_comment: On-demand only — invoked by the mission loop at milestone boundaries, never scheduled

tot_controller.description: Tree-of-Thought reasoning controller — self-contained: simulates three thinker perspectives (conservative / balanced / creative) in two rounds within one call and synthesises a verdict. Use for complex decisions requiring explored alternatives.
tot_controller._schedule_comment: On-demand only — triggered when a task benefits from multi-path reasoning
tot_controller._priority_comment: Runs early — its output can feed downstream agents such as business_planning

image_generation.description: Images from text — NVIDIA FLUX.3 Image Klein, auto-fallback FLUX.2 Klein 4B (tools/nvidia_image_gen.py)
image_generation._schedule_comment: On-demand only — generates images when a task asks for them

_hard_rules.code_generation: Never runs in parallel with any other agent — always runs alone in its own cycle
_hard_rules.deployment: Always the final agent in any run; always runs alone; requires code_generation to have completed this session
_hard_rules.grounded_review: Default child validator — always runs after the worker it checks, never before or alongside it
_hard_rules.user_testing_validator: Runs only at a mission milestone boundary, after every task in the milestone passed its own validator; never edits code; local targets only
_hard_rules.handoffs: Every worker ends its output with a === HANDOFF === block; a missing handoff fails validation
_hard_rules.validators: Every triggered worker is checked by a child validator before it counts as completed (grounded_review, or contract_check for idea_planner / tot_controller / Orchestrator). Add "validator": "grounded_review" | "contract_check" to an agent entry to override the default.

_agent_notes.missions: Long goals run as missions: Orchestrator plans (scope → contract → milestones), each background cycle advances one step, state in .opencode/memory/missions/
_agent_notes.tot_thinker: Disabled (disable: true) and unused — tot_controller is self-contained and never calls it. Not scheduled by RBG_Runner.
_agent_notes.Orchestrator: Sub-agent (01_orchestrator.md) used by RBG-Dev-seq, RBG-Dev-Parallel and rbg-fable-5.1 to plan worker + validator pairs — not directly scheduled by RBG_Runner. Replaces the former orchestrator_parallel.
_agent_notes.RBG-Dev-seq / RBG-Dev-Parallel / rbg-fab: Primary dev agents — user-selected entry points, not scheduled by RBG_Runner
_agent_notes.RBG_Runner: Self — excluded from the evaluation loop

condition_formats.file_exists:RBG_README.md: Pass if RBG_README.md exists in the project root
condition_formats.file_missing:RBG_README.md: Pass if RBG_README.md does NOT exist
condition_formats.after:idea_planner: Pass only after idea_planner has completed this session
